Image 1: Geometry/layout authority and edit target: keep every silhouette, position and size

Use case: sketch-to-render, game sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative geometry guide and edit target: reskin it, keeping every shape exactly where and how big it is on the 1536x1024 canvas. It holds two separate objects for a sci-fi strategy-game building prop (like a tabletop miniature terrain set), each seen from directly above. Left: a raised smooth gun pedestal about one storey (four metres) tall with rounded corners, seen from straight above, so its smooth sloped side walls show as the four bands round the rounded top deck: north and west faces lit, south and east faces in shade; it must read clearly as a tall solid form standing above the ground. A glowing light strip rims the deck, a smooth ramp with light strips runs down the south face (keep it as drawn), round fittings with glowing centres on three deck corners; the deck holds an empty dark circular ring well (leave the well dark and plain: a separate rotating house sits over it). Right: the heavy rotating gun house that sits on it: a large smooth oval shell with two swept rear fins, a glowing ring on its crown, a flush lens, and one long pipe wound with ring coils and ending in a glowing tip, pointing straight up the image. Material and style: Tri-Tachyon corporate high-tech: seamless white ceramic composite shells with smooth curves and no visible bolts, graphite-black underside bands and panel gaps, thin glowing cyan emitter seams and lenses where the guide shows the brightest lines and dots; pristine, precise, smooth satin finish; housings glossy white with graphite pipes and cyan light accents. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top-down like a strategy-game map sprite, no perspective tilt. Sun from the upper left: keep the guide's lit and shaded faces exactly where they are. Hand-painted gritty science-fiction game-sprite look like Starsector, restrained palette, coarse readable detail that survives being shrunk to about 30 to 40 pixels per cell. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no ground or terrain, no grass, no cast shadow outside the objects, no extra slab, apron or border. Transparent background outside every silhouette (if transparency is impossible, a flat pure white background). Change only material, surface detail and subtle shading, never placement, size or silhouette.
